steps.title: Charge
steps.imageAlt: USB-C cable plugged into the base of the Hydout

bullets.text: Plug **any USB-C cable** into the port on the base.
**Pass-through charging:** you can use it while it charges.
The display shows battery level while charging.
Give it a full charge before first use.

steps.title: Load
steps.imageAlt: Magnetic mouthpiece cover removed, 510 cartridge ready to thread in

bullets.text: **Screw in** your 510 cartridge: snug, not cranked.

note.text: Fits most 510-thread cartridges up to **2 g**. Cartridge sold separately.

steps.title: Activate
steps.imageAlt: Single control button on the side of the Hydout

press.sub: Hold the button or just inhale

note.text: Lower voltage = more flavor. Higher = bigger clouds.

steps.title: Clean
steps.imageAlt: Cotton swab cleaning the cartridge connection point
steps.image2Alt: Cotton swab cleaning inside the mouthpiece cover

bullets.text: **Turn it off** and remove the cartridge first.
Wipe the **inside of the mouthpiece cover**.

note.text: **Never soak the battery** in alcohol or any liquid.

faq.question: Nothing happens when I press the button
faq.answer: The device auto-sleeps after 10 minutes. Press five times to wake it. If the display still doesn't light up, charge it and try again.

faq.question: My cart isn't producing vapor
faq.answer: Make sure the cartridge is threaded in snugly, not over-tightened. Try a double-press for a 10-second preheat to loosen thick oil, then draw again: hold the button or just inhale.

faq.question: Which heat setting should I use?
faq.answer: Start low. Lower voltages give more flavor and make a cart last longer; higher voltages give bigger, warmer clouds. Press three times to cycle through the five settings.

faq.question: Will my cartridge fit?
faq.answer: The Hydout takes standard 510-thread cartridges up to 2 g. Very wide or extra-tall carts may keep the magnetic cover from seating flush.

faq.question: How do I know when it's fully charged?
faq.answer: The LED display shows the battery level. Leave it on the cable until it reads full.

faq.question: What does the warranty cover?
faq.answer: The Hydout comes with a **90-Day Limited Warranty**. Register your device and read the full terms on gpen.com, or contact support with your order details.
